convergence_assessment: The single-Goal/single-Task bounded route, existing sole RuntimeCoordinator/Host broker, current qualification and sealed evidence provide a usable base. The present proposal is not yet sufficient to enable business LIVE Goal acceptance. Resolve both blocking design gaps; a fixed pure scalar function first milestone can then be made finite and reviewable. No general repair-correctness guarantee follows from these tests.

blocking_findings.title: Test2json run/pass frames are not independent proof that frozen tests executed
source_based_path: The proposed contract permits modifying a production .go file. Current validation rejects init/TestMain only in selected _test.go files and runs during initial coding registration.

A modified production init can emit testing framing bytes and named RUN/PASS text, then exit0 before testing.M.Run. The locked Go test2json converter interprets those stdout frames as test events and a successful process exit as package pass. Testing exit0 protection is activated later in M.before.

Thus genuine Host sandbox execution and honest JSON conversion can produce the required event roster without running the frozen assertions. Final source hashes and full logs faithfully seal that implementation but do not make its reported tests true. No forged Host receipt or model self-report is needed.
blocking_findings.evidence_strength: Read-only source reasoning against the local locked toolchain; no exploit or product/test process was executed in this review.
blocking_findings.minimum_resolution: First version must constrain the actual staged and final-sealed bytes to a closed, independently checked pure scalar function grammar, or use a genuinely external trusted assertion runner. Keep ordinary LIVE Goal503 until that evidence boundary is implemented and reviewed.

blocking_findings.title: Task and Goal need distinct frozen acceptance contracts and checker snapshots
source_based_path: buildFiniteClientGoal currently assigns spec.Contract to both Goal and Task. clientTurnContract contains mandatory mu.turn-output-v1.

Goal uses the common prepareTaskAcceptance checker dispatch but its goalAcceptanceSnapshot has accepted tasks/artifacts, not a Task mu_turn snapshot. verifyMuTurn immediately fails when mu_turn is absent.

Adding only a private-binding LIVE503 exception and executing all original Goal checks therefore cannot converge to accepted Goal with the current shared contract shape. Simply skipping mu checks would weaken the Task evidence guarantee.
blocking_findings.minimum_resolution: Define separate versioned Task and Goal contracts in the normal creation transaction. Task requires mu.turn-output-v1 plus the restricted business checker. Goal requires an exact single-Task current independent PASS receipt/deliverable aggregation checker. Bind both contract hashes and exact Task/Goal IDs in the immutable private business binding; preserve existing finite-turn, planning and FIXTURE behavior.

minimum_versioned_constraints.requirement: Freeze exact package, file set, package declaration, function signature and allowed test names; permit one production file with no imports, init, top-level vars/initializers, directives/build tags, cgo, assembly, embed/linkname or extra generated source. Restrict function bodies to an explicit allowlist of scalar types/operators/control constructs; calls only to enumerated pure builtins/operations. Reject unknown AST forms, side-effectful builtins, function values/literals, go/defer, reflection/unsafe and any capability outside the grammar. A blacklist of os/fmt alone is insufficient.

Run that structural checker over the exact bytes staged for each check and the exact final sealed source bundle. Initial registration review alone is insufficient because business bytes are intentionally mutable. Include checker/version/hash and its verdict in protected Host evidence.

Continue requiring a strict complete -json stream, exact package/Test roster and actual run/pass pairs, no skip/fail/missing/duplicate terminal/unclosed process, uncached -count=1, successful timeout/resource/cleanup facts. These are necessary corroboration after source capabilities are constrained, not sole proof.

Seal full content-addressed source bytes, fixed tests and dependency/toolchain manifests; bind all required check IDs to the same Task/Run/epoch/profile and the final source manifest after the last write. Recheck snapshot, binding, policy and effect sequence at acceptance commit. SDK result remains unique by trusted Host role/identity; never select an arbitrary model-named Artifact or discard the full output vector.

State whether acceptance covers a sealed package bundle or the current mutable Workspace. Staging copies only frozen source_paths, so extra Workspace compile inputs cannot silently enter the check but must be rejected/reconciled if promising the whole Workspace. Define drift rejection through the acceptance instant and retain the immutable accepted Artifact; later user edits must not silently mutate the accepted bytes.

Require exclusive server-created business type/version binding for one Goal and one delivery Task, both contract hashes, current independent PASS Task receipt, exact sealed deliverables and all original Goal RBAC/authority/policy/context/ref checks. Reuse nativeDispatchProof and currentDispatchAdmission for that exact current accepted run. No exemption based only on task_type=mu_turn, command name, model output, user acceptance payload or a public contract Artifact.

Retain original Requirement/origin/candidate/input and retry/failure lineage in normal transactions. A fresh package/root, new Artifact ID or new business type must not reset a continuing failed attempt. Keep UNKNOWN cost/purpose/lease/cancellation and current qualification checks unchanged.

retain_from_proposal: Trusted first-use Workspace selection and current model/runtime qualification remain separate gates. Neither the fresh root nor this design review grants them.

Current native admission, RBAC/verifier authority separation, writer lease/epoch/CAS, exact effect provenance, budget/UNKNOWN treatment, cancelled-child cleanup and final snapshot revalidation remain mandatory.
Immutable sealed final source bytes and protected Host REPORT/LOG evidence are correct requirements; model-visible TOOL_RESULT and externally provided PASS files remain non-authoritative.
Unsupported ordinary LIVE Goal remains503; old finite-turn/planning/FIXTURE semantics and failure counters remain intact.
minimal_next_scope: Revise and freeze the private business binding/schema with distinct Task/Goal contracts and the closed pure-scalar grammar before enabling any LIVE exception.

Implement source-only deterministic structural checker, sealed bundle/snapshot/role binding and negative fixtures without native/model/resource execution. Include forgable test frames, late-added init/imports/directives, missing tests, hash drift, extra Workspace sources, post-check writes and swapped Artifact roles as rejecting cases.
After independent review of those components, implement the exact Goal aggregation checker/whitelist without relaxing unsupported Goal503 or existing current admission.
Actual native qualification and one real business delivery require a separate concrete current resource/scope decision; no resource was started here.
